LESSON: ISLAMIC MANNERS OF DRESSING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Islamic Manners of Dressing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Islamic Manners of Dressing, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How should a Muslim dress? 2. What is the importance of the Islamic code of dress?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify features of the Islamic code of dressing,

2. watch video clip on a digital device/observe charts/photos of different Islamic attires,

3. discuss the significance of the Islamic code of dressing and presents in class,

4. model an ideal Islamic dress in class. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify features of the Islamic code of dressing,
2. watch video clip on a digital device/observe charts/photos of different Islamic attires,
3. discuss the significance of the Islamic code of dressing and presents in class,
4. model an ideal Islamic dress in class. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Islamic Manners of Dressing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners watch video clip on a digital device

on different Islamic attires.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking is enhanced as learners discuss the significance of the

Islamic code of dressing and presents in class.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of making observations is enhanced as learners model Islamic dress in class.

Values:
• Respect is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinions during group discussion.

• Responsibility is enhanced as learners model an ideal Islamic dress in class.
